source: DECISIONS.md W-29 allowlist, exactly: (1) playbooks/music-sound.md DX-gated check ('not applied here' is body text about a broadcast anchor); (2) negations ('no co-keeper', 'Rings 1 and 2 are empty', 'there is no insider'); (3) a 25 next to 'tested at 25, UNVERIFIED at 24' or 'access copy only if a 50 Hz venue judders'; (4) 'Ring 1' inside 'gathering 14'. Nothing else may be added by an implementor: a new entry is an orchestrator decision.
how_it_works: A hit is allowed when its file matches 'file' (a glob under the repo root), its row is in 'rows', and context_regex matches somewhere in the hit's line and the 'window' lines before and after it. --audit-allowlist fails on any entry that suppresses nothing.
